title: Under the heart — the partner point R1

seo.title: Point R1 in the destiny matrix — the arcanum under the heart
seo.description: The arcanum under the heart in the destiny matrix: the partner point R1, the formula M + R, and what the middle of the relationship line shows in a couple.
queries: arcanum under the heart in the destiny matrix

meaning: The partner point is almost always called the one “under the heart”: on the scheme it sits right below the centre of the chart, which is usually drawn as a heart. In the method it has a name and a formula — R1, the middle of the relationship line M → R1 → R. It is counted in two steps: first the crossing of money and relationships R, as the sum of the relationship entry M and the money line entry L, then the point itself as the sum of M and R.

The entry of the line, M, answers for the first reaction to getting close, while R1 answers for what a couple starts to revolve around once the discovering is over and life together has begun. For one person that is about honesty and keeping score, for another about freedom, for a third about care that quietly turns into control. The arcanum here describes not the partner, but what a person brings into the couple on the second step.

Telling this point apart from the entry is easiest by the number. Point M only takes numbers that divide by three: 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21. The partner point takes any number from 3 to 22. So a “ten under the heart” or an “eleventh arcanum under the heart” is always R1, and there is no reason to mix it up with the entry of the line.

This point explains why things repeat: why with different people the conversation runs into the same wall. The script is set not by the partner’s character but by the question a person carries in with them. Until that question is said out loud, it gets settled at the couple’s expense — and comes back in the next couple. That is why R1 is read as part of the whole line and not on its own: the entry M shows how it all starts, the crossing R shows what it runs into, and the partner point between them answers what the couple is holding together for.
